notes: activity.csv from the "extended details" download: newest first, DD/MM/YYYY, Amount from Amex's side (a charge is positive, a payment or refund negative), multi-line Extended Details in quotes for foreign spend and airline tickets, Reference wrapped in single quotes, Category "Group-Subgroup". No balance, no currency column (GBP never stated). For the cardholder every charge is money out, so the expected amounts are the printed ones negated. LF assumed.
